findings.text: Early initialization service rewrites caller supplied NUMA memory description into emulated layout derived from fake topology request, refreshes parsed node set and affinity and distance state, and restores original parsed set with identity translation when emulation is disabled or cannot be constructed.

Registration service validates section mapping granularity against internode alignment and then publishes each cleaned memory extent into node assignment of physical memory allocator, after expanding possible nodes from parsed nodes.

Memory description is a counted collection of extents each carrying beginning address and exclusive end address plus owning node identity, accompanied by a reserved collection of same shape, with removal achieved by shifting later entries forward and decrementing count.

Emulation advances through sizing interpretation, distribution of physical capacity into emulated extents, validation of constructed layout, snapshot of physical distances, reconstruction of parsed set, affinity translation, completion of unmapped translations with a default, reconstruction of distance matrix including handling for extended identifiers, and release of snapshot, with any failure diverting to terminal fallback that reinstates original parsed set and identity translation.

Distance storage is created on first update with dimension one greater than highest parsed node, prefilled so self pairs use local value and other pairs use remote value, and later updates are ignored when endpoints lie outside dimension or when supplied value exceeds byte wide storage or when self pair carries nonlocal value.

Cleanup moves extents without RAM overlap into reserved storage, constrains remaining extents to DRAM span while diverting overflow above DRAM into reserved storage, discards emptied extents, rejects cross node intersections, warns on same node intersections, coalesces same node extents whose span avoids other node memory, and initializes trailing slots to empty with no node marker.

Capacity distribution cycles across physical nodes and carves prefixes from their current extents, supporting division by node count, division by fixed byte size, and per physical node uniform division, while discounting absent pages, respecting minimum granularity and maximum node limit, honoring low address boundary behavior, and enlarging current carve to avoid leaving an undersized remainder.

Each emulated extent takes leading bytes of selected physical extent, adopts supplied emulated identity, preserves first observed association between emulated and physical identities, advances physical beginning by consumed length, and drops physical extent once exhausted, failing when emulated capacity is already full.

Maximum emulated identity is highest index holding a mapped physical counterpart, and default physical identity is first mapped counterpart encountered in index order, remaining unmapped when no entry is mapped.

Affinity translation leaves unassociated processors unchanged and otherwise replaces physical identity with first emulated identity whose stored physical counterpart matches, defaulting to zero when no counterpart matches.
Overlap query reports true when size capped ranges intersect, DRAM beginning corresponds to base of first memory region, and DRAM termination corresponds to end of final memory region.

Absent accounting starts from full page interval length and subtracts portions covered by memory ranges, with hole size derived from absent pages in address interval and empty intervals contributing nothing.

Internode alignment derivation scans memory ranges in order, tracks transitions between node identities, builds a mask coarse enough to separate consecutive distinct nodes, accumulates masks across transitions, and converts final mask into page count.
Low address boundary for emulation combines DRAM beginning with a fixed size offset.
Invalid constructed layout, inability to snapshot physical distances, split failures, and map repair failures all abandon emulation without partial commit, restoring prior parsed set.

Addition paths reject invalid node identities and excessive table occupancy, ignore zero length ranges, and treat inverted ranges as ignorable with warning, preventing malformed extents from entering storage.
